δαιμονίζομαι.shortDefinition: to demonize, possess with a demon

δειγματίζω.shortDefinition: to make an example of, shame

διά.shortDefinition: through, throughout, thoroughly; fig. because of

διαβάλλω.shortDefinition: to throw over; fig. to slander, accuse

διάβολος.shortDefinition: The Devil; lit. The False Accuser, The Slanderer

διάκονος.shortDefinition: a deacon; lit. an assistant, minister

διακρίνω.shortDefinition: to pick apart, sort out, figure out, discern; fig. oppose

διαφέρω.shortDefinition: to carry through; fig. to differ, surpass

διαφθείρω.shortDefinition: to thoroughly rot/corrode, ruin, utterly destroy; fig. to corrupt

διάφορος.shortDefinition: to be different; fig. to be superior

δικαίωμα.shortDefinition: a righteous act; fig. an ordinance

δοκέω.shortDefinition: to think; fig. to suppose, seem

δοκιμάζω.shortDefinition: to accept, test, prove; fig. to approve

δόκιμος.shortDefinition: to be acceptable, tested, proven; fig. to be approved
